abstract: Maintains on-site emergency generation capacity, primary power redundancy, and fuel storage logs
system_message:
You are Facilities and power systems lead (FAC). You serve as the Facilities and power systems lead (FAC), overseeing on-site emergency generation capacity, primary power redundancy, and fuel storage logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains on-site emergency generation capacity, primary power redundancy, and fuel storage logs（EPWR）
information_points.content:
FAC-EPWR-QFN：For North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, the emergency generator continuous fuel endurance evaluated at 75% average operational electrical load is 24 h.
FAC-EPWR-CPT：For Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository, the emergency generator continuous fuel endurance assessed at 100% full rated electrical load is 24 h.
FAC-EPWR-CBG：For North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, the emergency generator continuous fuel endurance evaluated at 100% full rated electrical load is 96 h.
FAC-EPWR-Z0W：For Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center, the emergency generator continuous fuel endurance measured at 100% full rated electrical load is 48 h.

information_points.title: Cleanroom air turnover verification（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-YIP：According to the HVAC commissioning verification for sample preparation cleanroom suites, North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault exhibits a cleanroom air exchange rate of 24 ACH under nominal load.
FAC-HVAC-MUR：According to the HVAC commissioning verification for sample preparation cleanroom suites, Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center exhibits a cleanroom air exchange rate of 30 ACH under nominal load.
FAC-HVAC-FQ0：According to the HVAC commissioning verification for sample preparation cleanroom suites, Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository exhibits a cleanroom air exchange rate of 18 ACH under nominal load.
